name: Stefan Dušan's Law Code
summary: Stefan Dušan, at the height of his empire's power, promulgated his law code (Zakonik) at Skopje in 1349, supplemented in 1354. Drawing on Byzantine law, it codified the rights and obligations of every social class, nobility, clergy, peasants, along with commercial regulations and criminal penalties. It represented the apex of medieval Serbian legal development and remained influential for centuries.

_quarry.structural_significance: Serbia's most significant legal monument; reflected the Byzantine-influenced imperial ambitions of the Nemanjić dynasty at its peak.

sources_used: Soulis, The Serbs and Byzantium during the Reign of Tsar Stephen Dušan
